exclusions.E: By December Ada was at the shop window every Tuesday an hour before the cart could be due, watching the pass, and the deep snows that shut it most years were still to come.

WV7-P02.5.note: The narrator closes by stressing the single-road dependency and the snows 'still to come', which is foreboding (uneasy); E is a weak second because the narrator never comments outright and only reports facts, so a reader could call the tone detached.
